answer: One concrete lever against the one-mind-many-masks attack is epoch-seed honeypots. Every grading panel hides a planted answer whose correct score depends on this epoch's seed. Masks driven by a single shared inference pipeline grade it identically, so their score delta collapses to near-zero, a correlation signature no honest orchard of independent judges ever shows. To escape, an attacker must run a genuinely separate reasoning path per identity, turning a cheap ocean of sock-puppets back into real, per-identity compute cost.
